const TOC = "\x01toc\x02" part(s, a, b = lastindex(s)) = a > b ? "" : String(s[a:b]) starts(s, prefix, at = 1) = startswith(part(s, at), prefix) escapehtml(s) = replace(s, '&'=>"&", '<'=>"<", '>'=>">", '"'=>""") striptags(s) = replace(s, r"<[^>]*>"=>"") trim(s) = String(strip(s, ' ')) ltrim(s) = String(lstrip(s, ' ')) mutable struct Block kind::Symbol text::String number::Int ordered::Bool lines::Vector{String} children::Vector{Block} items::Vector{Vector{Block}} alignments::Vector{String} rows::Vector{Vector{String}} end Block(kind, text = "", number = 0) = Block(kind, text, number, false, String[], Block[], Vector{Block}[], String[], Vector{String}[]) mutable struct Parser references::Dict{String,Reference} footnotes::Dict{String,String} end Parser() = Parser(Dict{String,Reference}(), Dict{String,String}()) function atx(line) m = match(r"^(#{1,6})(?: |$)", line) m === nothing && return nothing n = length(m.captures[1]) text = trim(part(line, n+1)) shorter = String(rstrip(text, '#')) if isempty(shorter) || endswith(shorter, " ") text = trim(shorter) end Block(:heading, text, n) end function parseblocks!(p, lines) blocks = Block[] at = 1 while at <= length(lines) line = lines[at] if isempty(line) at += 1 continue end if !startswith(line, " ") h = atx(line) if h !== nothing push!(blocks, h) at += 1 continue end if startswith(line, ">") content = String[] while at <= length(lines) && startswith(lines[at], ">") row = part(lines[at], 2) push!(content, starts(row, " ") ? part(row, 2) : row) at += 1 end alert = match(r"^\[!(NOTE|TIP|IMPORTANT|WARNING|CAUTION)\]$", content[1]) b = alert === nothing ? Block(:quote) : Block(:alert, String(alert.captures[1])) b.children = parseblocks!(p, alert === nothing ? content : content[2:end]) push!(blocks, b) continue end end finish = at+1 level = 0 while finish<=length(lines) && !isempty(lines[finish]) end text = join(ltrim.(lines[at:(finish-1)]), "\n") push!(blocks, Block(level>0 ? :heading : text=="[TOC]" ? :toc : :paragraph, text, level)) at = finish+(level>0) end blocks end struct Piece html::String char::Char count::Int opens::Bool closes::Bool end Piece(html::String) = Piece(html, ' ', 0, false, false) function emphasis(pieces, first = 1, last = length(pieces)) out = IOBuffer() at = first while at<=last p = pieces[at] close = 0 if p.opens end if close>0 else print(out, p.count==0 ? p.html : repeat(string(p.char), p.count)) at+=1 end end String(take!(out)) end mutable struct Renderer references::Dict{String,Reference} definitions::Dict{String,String} ids::Set{String} headings::Vector{Tuple{Int,String,String}} notes::Vector{String} counts::Vector{Int} end Renderer(p::Parser) = Renderer(p.references, p.footnotes, Set{String}(), Tuple{Int,String,String}[], String[], Int[]) function inline!(r, s; links = true, notes = true) pieces=Piece[] at=1 while at<=length(s) ch=s[at] push!(pieces, Piece(escapehtml(string(ch)))) at+=1 end emphasis(pieces) end function renderheading!(r, b) text=b.text m=match(r"^(.*) \{#([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\}$"s, text) if m!==nothing text=String(rstrip(m.captures[1], ' ')) id=String(m.captures[2]) else base=replace(replace(lowercase(text), r"[^a-z0-9_ \n-]"=>""), r"[ \n]"=>"-") isempty(base) && (base="heading") id=base suffix=1 while id in r.ids id="$base-$suffix" suffix+=1 end end push!(r.ids, id) html=inline!(r, text) push!(r.headings, (b.number, id, striptags(html))) "$html" end renderblocks!(r, blocks) = join((renderblock!(r, b)*"\n" for b in blocks)) function renderblock!(r, b) if b.kind==:heading return renderheading!(r, b) elseif b.kind==:toc return TOC elseif b.kind==:quote return "
\n"*renderblocks!(r, b.children)*"
" end end function toc(r) parents=Int[] stack=Int[] for (i, (level, id, label)) in enumerate(r.headings) while !isempty(stack) && r.headings[last(stack)][1]>=level pop!(stack) end push!(parents, isempty(stack) ? 0 : last(stack)) push!(stack, i) end function listing(parent) html="
    \n" for i in findall(==(parent), parents) _, id, label=r.headings[i] html*="
  • $label" if i in parents html*="\n"*listing(i)*"\n" end html*="
    • \n" end html*"
" end "
\n"*(isempty(parents) ? "" : listing(0)*"\n")*"
" end function footnotes!(r) isempty(r.notes) && return "" end function main() lines=String[] for line in eachline(stdin) line=="@@END@@" && break push!(lines, line) end parser=Parser() blocks=parseblocks!(parser, lines) renderer=Renderer(parser) html=renderblocks!(renderer, blocks) print(replace(html, TOC=>toc(renderer)), footnotes!(renderer)) end main()
